lines.intro: A fizzy raccoon pops out by the school path, chattering at Fae!
lines.command: How can Fae calm the raccoon?

soothe.great: Fae hums a slow, sleepy song. The raccoon's swirly eyes start to slow down!
soothe.good: Fae hums softly. The raccoon tilts its masked face.
soothe.miss: The raccoon is too busy counting bottle caps to listen.

play.great: Maddie rolls a bottle cap across the ground. The raccoon chases it, chittering happily!
play.good: Maddie sniffs the raccoon's paw. It sniffs right back.
play.miss: Maddie pounces on the raccoon's tail. It squeaks and hops away.

cast.great: Sue casts a shiny lure. The raccoon catches it and spins with joy!
cast.good: Sue's lure glints in the sun. The raccoon's eyes follow it.
cast.miss: Sue's line tangles in a bush. The raccoon snickers.

juggle.great: Jordan juggles three pinecones. The raccoon claps its little paws!
juggle.good: Jordan tosses a pinecone high. The raccoon reaches for it.
juggle.miss: A pinecone bonks Jordan on the head. The raccoon rolls with laughter.

lines.snack: Fae shares a crunchy cracker. The raccoon washes it first, very carefully.
lines.burst: The raccoon flings a shower of shiny bottle caps at Fae!

burstResult.great: Clink, clink! Fae dodges every bottle cap!
burstResult.good: Fae dodges most of the bottle caps!
burstResult.miss: Plink! A bottle cap bounces off Fae's backpack.

lines.soothed: The raccoon lets out a sleepy chitter. The fizzy spell floats away!
lines.rest: Fae is all tuckered out. Time for a little rest.
lines.run: Fae backs away. The raccoon chatters by the school path.
